5. Zcash didn’t build in a vacuum.

Remember DigiShield?
Born in DigiByte → adopted by Zcash → then Dogecoin, BCH, others.

Same with zk libraries, trusted setups, recursive proofs — all open source.

Zcash pushed the stack forward.
